scope: Save/load lot 5: the original CPlayerObj, CMovement, CInventoryMgr (with its items) and CDestructable Save/Load byte bodies over the existing typed values, the client SaveClientData/LoadClientData blob, CMSG_SAVEGAME and SMSG_CLIENTSAVEDATA, the restored-client association and the shell console variables. Field order, types and Load side effects were selected from the references below; the bodies are written over the port's typed state. Selective excerpts are recorded in the provenance ledger.
